subject: Conditional capacity uplift & 60-day proof-of-performance request — NebulaCommerce
messages:
From: Olivia Park <olivia.park@nebulacommerce.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Khan <samir.k@nebulacommerce.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: temporary capacity uplift during Q4 promo window

Hi Marissa,

Quick note from the ops and product teams here — we are expecting a short-term traffic surge for our November campaign and would like to explore a conditional capacity uplift. The ask is: an additional 3x token throughput for a 60-day window, with an objective verification step (we'd run a 2-week live performance check).

Key constraints:
- We need latency p95 below 350ms for 95% of requests.
- Price protection for the test window (no retroactive re-billing if traffic spikes).
- Access to request-level audit logs for the period.

Happy to jump on a quick call to outline the traffic patterns — Samir is looped in.

Thanks,
Olivia
Olivia Park
Head of Platform Integrations
NebulaCommerce

Attachments: nebula-throughput-snapshot-q2.pdf (report)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Park <olivia.park@nebulacommerce.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Request: temporary capacity uplift during Q4 promo window

Hi Olivia — thanks for the heads-up and the snapshot. This is doable but will require a short proof-of-performance (PoP) and a conditional commercial addendum.

Proposal (high level):
- 60-day conditional uplift starting with a 14-day live verification window. If verification passes, we enable the 3x throughput pool for the remaining 46 days.
- Verification criteria: p95 latency <= 350ms, error rate < 0.5%, and qualitative review of output quality by your ML team (pass/fail checklist).
- Commercials: fixed uplift fee for the verification window to reserve capacity, then a time-limited tiered unit price for the 46-day enabled period (term sheet attached).
- Data & compliance: full request-level audit logs for the period; we’ll set retention to 90 days by default.
- Fall-back: if verification fails, we revert to baseline capacity and provide a one-time engineering credit for the trouble.

I’m attaching a term sheet and a sample canary config. Ben and Karthik — can you confirm the target pool sizing and whether 3x is achievable with autoscaled burst vs reserved slots?

Next step: 30-minute alignment call this week to lock the verification tests and DocuSign the conditional addendum. I’m available Wed/Thu afternoon PT.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference

Attachments: conditional-uplift-term-sheet-v2.docx, canary-config.json
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Olivia Park <olivia.park@nebulacommerce.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 17 Aug 2027 09:21:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Request: temporary capacity uplift during Q4 promo window

Marissa / Olivia — quick technical read:

We can achieve 3x sustained throughput for NebulaCommerce with these knobs:
- Short-term reserved burst slab (N-4 GPUs equivalent) + continuous batching tuned to your average sequence length (I used the Q2 snapshot).
- Autoscaling warm-up: pre-warm the KV cache and model shards 48 hours prior to the start.
- Canary plan (attached) will run synthetic traffic and a subset of live traffic: canary passes if p95 < 340ms and token generation quality metrics hold.

Risks:
- If your 95th-percentile sequences are significantly longer in production than Q2 snapshots, we’ll need to re-evaluate; this can increase latency.
- Audit logs: we can provide request-level logs but need a signed SLA appendix for retention and access formatting.

I’ll prepare an ops playbook for the verification window and a checklist for your ML reviewers.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
From: Samir Khan <samir.k@nebulacommerce.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Olivia Park <olivia.park@nebulacommerce.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Aug 2027 10:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Conditional capacity uplift & 60-day proof-of-performance request — NebulaCommerce

Thanks — this looks reasonable. A couple of follow-ups from our security team:

- Can you confirm the format for the request-level logs (JSON lines with request_id, timestamp, model_id, tokens_in, tokens_out)? We need to ingest into our SIEM.
- For price protection: we need a clause that the verification window usage will not be billed at the post-uplift rate retroactively.
- DocuSign: can you share the addendum so procurement can start the legal review?

Also, one ask on observability: during the 14-day verification can we get a per-hour latency dashboard link and a daily summary email? That will speed sign-off.

Samir
VP Product — NebulaCommerce
